leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reusable confirmation dialog component with customizable messages
Implement a service function that triggers the dialog and returns a promise
Configure the dialog to accept user confirmation or cancellation
Integrate the dialog service into existing UI components
Initialize and control the dialog's visibility state programmatically
Bind user actions to resolve or reject the dialog promise
Manipulate the DOM to render the dialog dynamically when triggered
